subtitle: Slingshot mini golf + pinball
description:
Pull back. Let it fly. Bank it off everything.

Bank Shot Extreme is slingshot mini golf with a pinball heart. Every level gives you 15 seconds and 6 shots to sink the ball, and the clock is always running.

Ricochet off the walls. Ride the bumpers. Thread the fork gates. Roll over multiplier squares to stack your score, then sink it with time to spare for bonus points.

Just when you think you've got it, the repellers show up and push your shot off line. Now every bank has to be planned.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 100 hand-tuned levels that get trickier as you climb
- Replay any level you've beaten and chase a better score
- Five looks: Neon, Golf, Paper, plus new Harvest and Holiday themes
- Game Center leaderboard: see how your best run stacks up
- One-thumb controls, built for quick sessions

NO NONSENSE
Pay once. No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases. Plays offline, so it's perfect for flights, waiting rooms and "one more level" before bed.
promo: New Holiday and Harvest themes! 100 levels of trick shots: pull back, bank it off the walls and sink it in 15 seconds.
reviewNote: Tap Go, then drag back from the ball and release to shoot. Sink the ball in the hole within 15 seconds and 6 shots to clear the level. Tap the Level button to pick any unlocked level. The gear button opens Settings: choose a theme, open the Game Center leaderboard, or reset all scores (with a confirmation). Game Center sign-in is optional; the game works fully without it. No account needed.
whatsNew:
